standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers surjective etale h_U -> F to the associated 1-morphism.

core_obligations: (2) implies (3) by taking F = X; (1) and (2) are equivalent by the invariance lemma; reduce to (2).
S_F is a stack in sets since F is a sheaf, a fortiori a stack in groupoids.
Identify Delta_{S_F} with S_F -> S_{F x F} coming from the diagonal of F; it is representable by algebraic spaces via the morphism-of-spaces lemma.
A surjective etale h_U -> F of algebraic spaces gives the surjective etale presentation (Sch/U) -> S_F via the presheaf transfer lemma.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to (2); stack-in-sets observation; diagonal identification; etale presentation transfer.
difficulty_reason: A three-part reduction with a genuine diagonal identification; the presentation transfer is a named-lemma application.
